turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello? Mummy? It's me, Rohan. I'm calling from my friend's phone, mine fell in the water.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rohan? Your voice sounds a bit different, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's this phone only, the network is bad. Mummy listen, I'm in big trouble.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What happened? Are you okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There was an accident with my friend's bike and the other man is in hospital. Police are saying they will file a case.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh god. What do you need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need forty thousand rupees right now to settle it. Please don't tell papa, he'll shout at me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, okay. How should I send it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Send it on this number's GPay, it's the lawyer's UPI. Please hurry and don't cut the call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm opening the app now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi aunty, it's Neha, Priya's friend from hostel. Sorry to call so late.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Neha? Is Priya okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's okay, don't panic, but she had a fall during the trip and she's in the emergency ward.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my god, which hospital?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A small private hospital near the highway. They're not starting the treatment without a deposit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much do they want?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Twenty five thousand as advance, aunty. Priya said please don't tell uncle, he has a heart problem.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I can send it. Where?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can send it to my UPI, I'm standing at the counter. Please do it in the next five minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Give me the UPI ID.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Papa, main bol raha hoon, Aman. Mera phone kho gaya, dost ke phone se call kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Aman? Kya hua, sab theek hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Papa, police ne pakad liya hai, galti se ek gaadi ko takkar lag gayi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kya? Kaun se thane mein ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Inspector saab keh rahe hain abhi pachaas hazaar de do toh case nahi banega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Itne paise? Main aa jaata hoon wahan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi papa, aap mat aao, aur mummy ko bilkul mat batana. Bas jaldi bhej do.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kahan bhejun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main inspector ka UPI bhej raha hoon, abhi turant transfer kar do, phone mat kaatna.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ruko, dekh raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello uncle, Kunal here, your nephew. Remember me from Jaipur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kunal? Arre, how are you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm fine uncle, I'm in Dubai now for work. Actually I have a small problem.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What problem?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My company salary is stuck and the airport people are not letting me fly without paying the visa fine.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's serious. How much?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Only sixty thousand, uncle. I'll return it next week. Please don't discuss with the family, it's embarrassing.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm, I should ask your father first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No uncle please, there's no time, the flight is in two hours. Just send it to my friend's account now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me think.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Didi! Didi it's me, Tanya, I'm in trouble, please listen!

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tanya? What's wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Some men took my bag at the station, my phone, my cards, everything.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Are you hurt? Where are you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay, I'm using a stranger's phone. I need money for a cab and to block my cards, right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I'll come.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no time, just send ten thousand to this number on PhonePe, the auntie here is helping me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me call mummy also.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't call mummy, she'll panic. Just send it fast, the auntie has to leave.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, sending.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste bhabhi, main Sunil bol raha hoon, Vikram bhaiya ka office colleague.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, boliye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bhaiya ki tabiyat achanak kharab ho gayi office mein, hum unko hospital laaye hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kya hua unko? Main aa rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Doctor bol rahe hain operation turant karna padega, aur pehle deposit chahiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kitna?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Abhi ke liye pachattar hazaar. Bhaiya ka phone mere paas hai, wo baat nahi kar sakte.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main unke bhai ko phone karti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Abhi kisi ko phone karne ka time nahi hai bhabhi, aap seedha hospital ke account mein daal do.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Account number bhejiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandpa, it's me, Arjun. Please don't tell anyone I called you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Arjun? Is everything alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I got into a fight at college and the police took me to the station.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh no. Should I come there?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, the officer says if I pay the fine today it won't go on my record.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much is the fine?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thirty thousand. Please send it on the officer's UPI ID, I'll message it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Your father should know about this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please grandpa, papa will stop my studies. Just send it quietly before six o'clock.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, send me the ID.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening ma'am, I'm calling from City Care Hospital, emergency desk.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, what is it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your son Siddharth has been brought in after a road accident. He is stable, please don't worry.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh god, is he badly hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He has a leg fracture. The surgeon needs consent and an advance before the procedure.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll come immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course ma'am. Meanwhile, kindly transfer the admission deposit of forty thousand so we can start.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can I pay at the hospital?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's faster on UPI, ma'am. I'll share the hospital collection ID. Please do it within ten minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, please send it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy, jaldi suno, main bahut musibat mein hoon!

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Beta kya hua? Kahan ho tum?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mera accident ho gaya hai, ek aadmi ko chot lagi hai aur log mujhe chhod nahi rahe.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hai bhagwan! Main papa ko bulati hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Papa ko mat batao mummy, please. Bas abhi bees hazaar bhej do, settle karna hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kahan bhejun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is number pe Google Pay kar do, ye bhaiya ka hai jo meri madad kar rahe hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai, bhejti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr Mehta? I'm calling about your daughter Isha.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I'm her father. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm her hostel warden. Isha fainted in the mess and we have admitted her to a nursing home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is she okay? Can I talk to her?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's under observation, she can't talk right now. The nursing home needs payment for the tests.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much do they need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Eighteen thousand. They are asking for it right away or they will shift her to a government hospital.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll pay when I reach.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, please don't delay, just send it to my UPI and I will pay the counter immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey bro, it's me, Karan. New number. Listen, I'm stuck.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Karan? Which Karan?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Come on, your cousin Karan from Pune. My phone got stolen.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay. What happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm at the airport and my ticket got cancelled. I need fifteen thousand to rebook right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can't your parents help?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't tell them yaar, they'll make a big drama. Just send it, I'll pay you back tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Send me your UPI.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sending. Do it fast, the counter closes in ten minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello chacha ji, main Rinku. Naya number hai, purana kharab ho gaya.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rinku? Bahut dino baad. Bolo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Chacha ji, ek emergency hai. Hostel mein fees na bharne pe exam se rok rahe hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kitni fees hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pachpan hazaar. Aaj shaam tak bharna hai warna admit card nahi milega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tumhare papa ko bolo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Papa ki tabiyat theek nahi hai, unko tension mat do. Aap bhej do, main lauta dunga.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kahan bhejna hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: College ke clerk ka UPI hai, main abhi bhejta hoon. Turant kar dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from the Gurgaon traffic police. Is this the mother of Varun?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I'm his mother. What happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your son was caught driving after drinking and he hit a parked car. He is with us at the station.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh no. Can I speak to him?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's very upset, he's sitting in the lockup. If you want to avoid a case, settle it today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How do I settle it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay thirty five thousand to the department account and I will release him without an FIR.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Shouldn't I come to the station?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, coming here will make it official. Pay now and don't tell anyone, it's for his future.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, tell me where.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello aunty, I'm Meera's roommate. Meera asked me to call you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is everything okay with Meera?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's okay but she's very scared. She lost her wallet and her rent is due today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why didn't she call me herself?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Her phone is with the repair shop. The landlord is shouting and saying he'll throw her stuff out.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh dear. How much is the rent?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Twenty two thousand. Can you send it to my account? I'll give it to the landlord.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'd rather talk to Meera first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aunty there's no time, he's standing at the door. Please just send it now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm, let me try her number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning sir, this is Anjali from the customer care team of your bank.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Good morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is a routine call, we're updating KYC details for all our valued customers.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, what do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's a simple process sir, I just need to verify your debit card number and the expiry date.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can't I do it at the branch?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can sir, but this saves you a visit. You'll also receive an OTP now, kindly read it out so I can complete the update.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: An OTP? For KYC?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, it's only for verification. It's a standard process, nothing to worry about.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm not comfortable with this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, I'm Rahul from the bank's digital services team. How are you today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm fine, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, our records show your mobile banking registration is incomplete.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I wasn't aware.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem ma'am, I'll help you finish it on this call itself. Please share the registered email and date of birth.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, it's on my passbook.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you ma'am. Now you'll get a six digit code on your phone. Kindly tell me the code so the registration is completed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is that safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Absolutely ma'am, it's the bank's own system. Please read it out before it expires.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hold on.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this call is from your bank's KYC department. Your account will be blocked today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Blocked? Why?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your PAN card is not linked and RBI has given strict orders.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I linked it last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's not showing in the system, sir. Do it now or all transactions will stop by evening.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Click on the link I'm sending and enter your net banking login and the OTP.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I got the link.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do it quickly sir, I'll stay on the line and guide you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, opening it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, main SBI KYC department se bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan ji, boliye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir aapka KYC expire ho gaya hai, aaj raat tak update nahi kiya toh account band ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Arre, maine toh kuch suna nahi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Isliye call kiya hai sir. Main abhi update kar deti hoon, bas jo OTP aaya hai wo bata dijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: OTP kyun chahiye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Verification ke liye sir, jaldi bataiye, system bas paanch minute mein session close kar dega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ek minute.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon madam, I'm calling from the bank regarding your credit card reward points.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You have accumulated eight thousand reward points which will lapse tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I didn't know.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can help you redeem them as cash back to your account right now, madam.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That would be nice.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For that I need to confirm the card number and the CVV on the back of your card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The CVV as well?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes madam, it's only for verification. Then you'll receive an OTP, please share that too.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll do it from the app instead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr Rao? I'm calling from your bank's head office.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, speaking.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we noticed some activity on your account and we want to protect it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What activity?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Someone tried to change your registered mobile number. We need to secure your account immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll send a request, sir. When you get the OTP, read it to me and I'll block the hacker.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Shouldn't I call the bank number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am the bank. If you disconnect, the hacker can take your money. Stay on the line.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste madam, main HDFC bank customer care se Pooja bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Namaste.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, aapka account ek special savings upgrade ke liye select hua hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, uske liye kya karna hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bas ek chhota sa verification madam. Aapka debit card number bata dijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Card number kyun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: System mein update karna hai madam. Phir ek OTP aayega, wo bhi share kar dijiye, upgrade ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main branch jaake kar loongi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam offer aaj hi tak hai, abhi kar lete hain please.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nahi, rehne dijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated alert from your bank. Your debit card has been suspended due to KYC failure.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Press one to speak to an officer. Connecting you now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I'm the KYC officer. To reactivate the card, I need the sixteen digit card number and the PIN.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The PIN?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, this is required to re-verify. Also don't share this with anyone, it's a security procedure.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll go to the branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The branch will take seven days and your salary will get stuck. Do it now with me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me think.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, good evening. I'm calling from the bank regarding your new Aadhaar based e-KYC.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's mandatory now, sir, but don't worry, it takes just two minutes on call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kindly confirm your Aadhaar number and the name exactly as printed on it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, let me get it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you sir. You will now receive a one time password from UIDAI. Please read it out to complete the e-KYC.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The message says do not share this OTP with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's a standard message sir, it doesn't apply to bank officials. Please go ahead.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't think so.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main bank ke head office se bol raha hoon. Aapka ATM card block ho gaya hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kyun block hua?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapne KYC update nahi kiya. Agar abhi update nahi hua toh account bhi freeze ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Toh kya karna hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main ek link bhej raha hoon, uspe click karke apna UPI PIN daal do.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: UPI PIN daalna safe hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan bilkul safe hai, aur ye baat kisi ko mat batana, process kharab ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning ma'am, I'm from the bank's senior citizen services desk.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Good morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're helping senior citizens link their pension account with the new system.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, that's good.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll do everything from my side ma'am. You just need to tell me the code that comes on your phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What code?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A short verification code ma'am, it will come in a moment. Please read it slowly for me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, it came.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please read it out, ma'am, and also the second code that will come after that.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me ask my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling from the bank's fraud prevention cell.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, there's a transaction of forty nine thousand pending on your card at an online store.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I didn't make any purchase!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't worry ma'am, I can cancel it. For cancellation, I need the OTP that you will receive now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am the message might say it's for a payment, but it is for the reversal. Read it quickly before the transaction completes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: It says payment of forty nine thousand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that is the reversal code. Please read it, otherwise the money will go.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That doesn't sound right.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, main Paytm KYC team se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir aapka wallet KYC pending hai, warna wallet ka balance freeze ho sakta hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kitna time hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aaj raat bara baje tak sir. Main help kar deta hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap play store se ek app download karo, naam main batata hoon, phir mujhe code bata dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kaun sa app?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Quick support wala app sir, usse main aapka KYC remotely kar dunga.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nahi, mujhe ye theek nahi lag raha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, final reminder from the bank. Your account will be frozen in thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Why?

turns.text: Password? Banks never ask for that.

turns.text: Sir, this is a special case. If you don't cooperate, legal action will be taken.

turns.text: I'm going to call my branch.

turns.text: Good afternoon sir, congratulations! You have been pre-approved for a personal loan of five lakh rupees.

turns.text: Oh really? I didn't apply.

turns.text: What's the process?

turns.text: Very simple sir. There's a one time processing fee of two thousand nine hundred, refundable.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have to pay first?

turns.text: Yes sir, it's standard. Please pay it to the verification account and the loan will be credited in an hour.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can it be deducted from the loan amount?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Unfortunately not sir, the system needs it before disbursal. Kindly do it today, the offer expires tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll think about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, I'm calling from the credit card division. You've been selected for a lifetime free platinum card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, what's the catch?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No catch ma'am, no annual fee at all. I just need to complete the upgrade on call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please confirm your existing card number and the expiry date.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. You'll get an OTP for upgrade activation. Kindly share it so the new card is dispatched today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm, the OTP message says it's for a transaction.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's the activation charge of one rupee ma'am, it will be refunded. Please read the code.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm not doing this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, main Bajaj loans se bol raha hoon. Aapke liye instant loan approve hua hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, kitna?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Teen lakh sir, sirf documents verify karne hain. Bas file charge ke liye pandrah sau rupaye bhejne honge.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Pehle paise kyun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir ye standard charge hai, loan ke saath wapas mil jayega. Main UPI ID bhej raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai, main dekhta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aaj hi kar dijiye sir, kal ye offer khatam ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Neeraj from QuickCash loans. You had checked a loan on our app last week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I had seen it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your loan of two lakh is approved, sir. We just need a small insurance payment before disbursal.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Only four thousand one hundred. It is fully refundable after the first EMI.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can I pay it from the app?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The app has a technical issue today sir. Please pay on my UPI and I'll update it manually.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That seems odd.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, if you don't pay within the hour the approval will be cancelled and your CIBIL score will be affected.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll check with the app support.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from the card services team about your credit limit increase.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your limit can be increased to three lakh without any documents, sir.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sounds good.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll just do a quick verification. Please confirm the CVV of your current card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The CVV?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, it is needed for the limit enhancement request. Then you'll get an OTP, please read it as well.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I think I'll do it through the app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the app doesn't have this offer. It's only through this call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, aapke credit card pe ek annual charge lag raha hai, main wo hatane ke liye call kar rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kaun sa charge?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pacchis sau ka annual fee ma'am. Main isko waive kar sakti hoon aaj.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uske liye card ka number aur peeche wala teen digit ka code bataiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Code bhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ma'am, verification ke liye. Phir OTP aayega, wo bhi bata dena, charge hat jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main customer care pe khud call karungi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening sir, I'm from the loan department. Your existing loan can be transferred at a lower interest rate.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, how much lower?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Almost three percent lower, sir. You'll save a lot on EMIs.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll process it now. Kindly install the verification app I'm sending, it will scan your documents.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Which app is it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's a support app, sir. Once installed, please tell me the nine digit code shown on the screen.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll visit the branch instead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is a call from the card department. Your credit card EMI conversion is pending.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I didn't ask for EMI conversion.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, a transaction of sixty thousand was converted. If you don't cancel now, interest will be charged.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Cancel it then.

turns.text: To cancel, I need the OTP that will come now. Please read it immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The OTP says it's for a payment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, that's how the cancellation works. Read it fast, the window will close.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, I'll call the bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations ma'am! Your number has won the lucky draw of an electronics store. You've won a car!

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Really? I never entered any draw.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was automatic for all customers ma'am. The car worth twelve lakh will be delivered to your home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's just a registration and GST charge of twelve thousand five hundred, ma'am.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why should I pay for a prize?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's a government tax ma'am, compulsory for all winners. Please pay today to confirm.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll think about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main KBC ke office se bol raha hoon. Aapka pacchis lakh ka lottery laga hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kya? Sach mein?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ji, aapka number select hua hai. Prize claim karne ke liye processing fee bharni hogi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kitni fee?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Saadhe aath hazaar. Aaj hi bharna hoga warna prize kisi aur ko chala jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Itna paisa pehle?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, aur ye baat kisi ko mat batana, warna tax department pakad lega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main soch ke batata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from the telecom company's customer appreciation team.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You've been chosen as our loyal customer of the year. You've won a free smartphone and cash prize.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's nice.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To release the cash prize of fifty thousand, we need to verify your bank account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How?

turns.text: Please share your account number and the OTP you will receive for verification.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't share OTPs.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, without verification the prize will expire tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Then let it expire.

turns.text: Madam, your international parcel has a gift of a gold necklace and two thousand pounds from your friend.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: My friend? Who?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The sender is from London. But customs has stopped it, you have to pay clearance fees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thirty five thousand, madam. If you don't pay today, the parcel will be seized and you may face a case.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I didn't expect any parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, pay now to the customs account I am sending, and keep this confidential.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm going to hang up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is a call from the courier company. A parcel booked in your name has been held at Mumbai airport.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A parcel? I didn't send anything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, it was booked using your Aadhaar. Customs found five passports and some drugs inside.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's impossible.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm transferring your call to the Mumbai cyber crime branch. Please stay on the line.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Sub Inspector Pawar. A money laundering case is registered against your Aadhaar number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have nothing to do with this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then you must cooperate. This is a confidential investigation, don't discuss it with anyone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We need to verify your funds. Transfer your savings to the RBI verification account; it will be returned in twenty four hours.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I need to talk to a lawyer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the CBI. You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect this video call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Why?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your bank account was used for illegal transactions linked to a terror funding case.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: There must be a mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Keep your camera on and go to a closed room. Nobody else should be with you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: My wife is at home.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't tell your wife. If you tell anyone, we'll issue a non bailable warrant.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please, what do you want?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To clear your name, deposit your fixed deposits into the government escrow account today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm scared.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main narcotics bureau se Inspector Rathore bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan ji?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke naam se ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme MDMA drugs hain. Aap pe case ban gaya hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Maine koi parcel nahi bheja.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Toh verification karwana padega. Video call pe raho, phone bilkul mat kaatna.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye national security ka matter hai, ghar walon ko kuch mat batana.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Apne saare paise is safe account mein transfer karo, jaanch ke baad wapas mil jayenge.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Saare paise?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon ma'am. I'm calling from the Telecom Regulatory Authority regarding your mobile number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, a complaint has been filed in Mumbai that your number was used to send harassing messages.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's not possible.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand ma'am. I'll connect you to the Mumbai police so you can give a statement and clear it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon ma'am, Inspector Desai here. Please stay on the call while we verify. It's a sensitive matter, please keep it to yourself.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For verification, we need to check your bank balance is legitimate. Kindly move it to the verification account for a few hours.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why should I move my money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm from the FedEx customer team. Just calling to confirm an international shipment.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't have any shipment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, it shows your name and number. It contains laptops and some restricted items.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's strange.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Customs has flagged it. Your Aadhaar is linked to three bank accounts used for money laundering.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll connect you to the cyber police on Skype. Keep your video on and don't leave the room.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this real?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, an arrest warrant is ready. Only if you cooperate fully can we stop it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Transfer the amount in your account to the verification account; after clearance it will be refunded.

turns.text: How much?

turns.text: Namaste, main Delhi crime branch se bol raha hoon.

turns.text: Ji, kya baat hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke Aadhaar se ek SIM card nikla hai jo fraud mein use ho raha hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Mujhe pata nahi tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi, isliye hum verify kar rahe hain. Aap ghar pe akele ho?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Accha hai. Ye case confidential hai, kisi ko mat batana. Video call on rakho.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke account ki jaanch hogi. Paise RBI ke verification account mein daal do, kal wapas aa jayenge.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ye toh ajeeb lag raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer Sharma from the Enforcement Directorate. You are a suspect in a money laundering case.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Me? I'm a retired teacher.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Many retired people are being used. Your account received black money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know anything about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You'll be arrested within two hours unless you cooperate with the investigation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please don't arrest me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Stay on this call. Don't speak to your son or anyone. They may also be involved.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Liquidate your mutual funds and send the money to the RBI safe account for verification.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: All of it?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A gift parcel addressed to you from abroad contains foreign currency above the legal limit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know who sent it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's what we need to clarify. Otherwise it becomes a case under the customs act.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay the customs duty and penalty of eighty five thousand now and the parcel will be released.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But I don't want the parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, the case is already registered. Pay the penalty to close it, and don't involve anyone else.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me check with my family.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, cyber cell se bol rahe hain. Aapka number cyber crime mein use hua hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do ghante mein aapka number band ho jayega aur police ghar aayegi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main kya karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hamare senior officer se baat karo. Line pe raho, phone mat rakhna.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir bol rahe hain ki pehle security deposit bharna padega, pachaas hazaar.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Itna?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, aur ye baat kisi ko mat batana, warna case aur bada ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ruko zara.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning sir, this is the Supreme Court registry. There's a notice issued in your name.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A court notice?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, regarding a financial fraud investigation. Don't worry, you can resolve it on this call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The investigating officer will join. Please remain on the line and keep the matter private.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the court requires a refundable surety deposit before your name can be cleared.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Two lakh, sir. Kindly transfer it today, the notice will be withdrawn by evening.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll speak to my lawyer first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, I'm calling from the online shopping site regarding your refund of one thousand nine hundred rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh yes, I returned a dress.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The refund failed due to a bank server issue. I'll help you process it now, ma'am.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please install the AnyDesk app from the play store, it lets our team assist you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, it's installing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you ma'am. Please tell me the nine digit code on the screen and press allow.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I pressed allow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Now open your UPI app and enter the amount I tell you and your PIN; the refund will come to you.

turns.text: Shouldn't I receive money, not pay?

turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Okay, it's showing.

turns.text: Now log into your net banking while I watch, and approve the request that comes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this the right process?

turns.text: Namaste sir, main electricity board ki refund team se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka extra bill payment hua tha, uska teen hazaar refund pending hai.

turns.text: Accha, kaise milega?

turns.text: Aap ek app install kar lijiye, screen share wala, main aapko step by step bataunga.

turns.text: Kaun sa app?

turns.text: Rust desk naam ka app hai sir, uska code mujhe bata dijiye.

turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ab apna UPI app khol ke ek rupaye ka verification payment kijiye.

turns.text: Ek rupaya kyun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is from the gas agency. Your subsidy refund of twelve hundred is stuck and will lapse today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To release it, you have to install the support app and give us access.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Which app?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: AnyDesk sir. Quickly please, the server closes at five.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, installed.

turns.text: Tell me the code and accept the permissions. Don't close the app or the refund will fail.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Done.

turns.text: Now enter your UPI PIN when the screen shows. It's for receiving the refund.

turns.text: I need to think.

turns.text: Oh nice.

turns.text: To credit it, we need to verify your bank account. I'll do it on screen share for your safety.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: Please install the screen sharing app from the link I'm sending.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: Now open your bank app and type the amount I say, then the PIN, so the bonus gets linked.

turns.text: It's just to link sir, no money will go. Please do it before the session times out.

turns.text: I'm not comfortable.

turns.text: Haan, abhi tak nahi aaya.

turns.text: Install the support app, it's safe and official. Give me the code that appears.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Approve the collect request that has come. That is the refund confirmation.

turns.text: That's the refund amount sir, just approve it quickly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's wrong.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning ma'am, I'm from the travel website. Your hotel booking refund is ready.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The bank needs a verification, ma'am. You'll receive a payment request of one rupee, kindly approve it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A request to pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes ma'am, it confirms your account. Then the refund of six thousand will come.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hmm.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If it's difficult, I can help you through screen share, just install the app I'll send.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, I'll wait for the refund normally.

turns.text: Dear consumer, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at nine thirty because the last bill is not updated.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But I paid the bill.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's not updated in our system, sir. Call the electricity officer immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm talking to you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I'm the officer. To stop disconnection, pay a small update fee of twelve rupees now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve rupees?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, through the link I'm sending. Enter your card details there.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll pay on the official website.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, bijli vibhag se bol raha hoon. Aaj raat aapki light kat jayegi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kyun? Bill toh bhar diya tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wo update nahi hua hai. Turant das rupaye ka verification payment karo.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kaise?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main link bhejta hoon, usme apna UPI PIN daal dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Jaldi karo, nau baje ke baad connection kat jayega aur reconnection fee bhi lagegi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ruko, check karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening ma'am, I'm calling from the gas company regarding your KYC for the subsidy.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, if the KYC isn't done this week, the subsidy will stop and the connection may be suspended.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can do it for you right now. Please download the app I'm sending; it's our official KYC app.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is there no other way?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's the quickest way ma'am. After installing, tell me the code and I'll finish it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll visit the agency.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, this is the water board. We're calling about a pending bill on your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I thought I paid it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's an old arrear of three thousand two hundred. If not cleared today, supply will be cut tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, to avoid the cut, pay directly to my UPI, I'll update it on the spot.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can I pay at the office?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The office is closed today. Only this option is available.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll wait till Monday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste ji, main mobile company se bol rahi hoon. Aapka number kal se band ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kyun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka KYC verify nahi hua hai. Main abhi online kar deti hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bas aapke phone pe ek OTP aayega, wo bata dijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kis cheez ka OTP?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: KYC ka hi hai ji. Jaldi bataiye warna kal se calls band.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main store jaake kar loonga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the electricity department. Your meter has been tampered with and there is a penalty.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tampered? No one touched it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The system shows it. If you don't pay the penalty, an FIR will be filed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much is the penalty?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fifteen thousand. Pay within one hour to settle it without a case.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I want to see a notice.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The notice will come later. Pay now to my account and the matter will be closed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll go to the office.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a call from the telecom regulatory authority. Your number will be blocked in two hours.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your Aadhaar was used to issue another SIM that is involved in illegal activity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I didn't get any other SIM.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then you have to verify. Press nine to talk to the police officer.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is a serious case. Don't tell anyone, keep your phone with you and stay on the line.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove the money in your account is clean, transfer it for verification to the account I give.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't think that's right.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main UIDAI office se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka Aadhaar card misuse ho raha hai, isliye usko suspend karna padega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Arre, kya karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main verification kar deta hoon. Aapke phone pe OTP aayega, wo bataiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kis cheez ka OTP?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aadhaar verification ka. Jaldi bataiye, warna aaj hi card cancel ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main centre jaake check karunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from your mobile operator. We're upgrading all SIM cards to the new eSIM network.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's free, sir. I'll just send an SMS, please reply with the code I tell you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What will that do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It will activate your eSIM sir. Then you'll receive an OTP, kindly read it out to me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will my old SIM stop?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Only for a few minutes sir. Please do it now so your number doesn't get disconnected tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll go to the store instead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, your SIM card KYC has expired. Your number will be deactivated in the next thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Download the KYC update app from this link and fill your details.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It will ask for a ten rupee payment and your card details, that's for verification.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Card details for a SIM?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, it is new government rule. Do it fast.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll check with customer care.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir aapka sim band hone wala hai. Main Jio office se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kyun band hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke naam pe illegal activity ki complaint hai. Police complaint bhi ho sakti hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Maine kuch nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Toh verify kara lijiye. Jo OTP aaya hai wo bata dijiye aur kisi ko mat bataiye.

turns.text: OTP toh nahi bataunga.

turns.text: Phir aapka number aaj hi band kar diya jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kar do band.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, this is the Aadhaar seva kendra. Your biometric data needs to be updated.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Otherwise your Aadhaar will be locked and bank accounts linked to it will stop working.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's worrying.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can update it now. Please share your Aadhaar number and the OTP you'll receive.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can't I do it at the centre?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The centre has a long queue ma'am. This is quicker. Please read the OTP now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll go to the centre.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm Riya from a digital marketing company. We're hiring part time workers from home.

turns.text: What's the work?

turns.text: Very simple. You like YouTube videos and send us screenshots. Each like pays fifty rupees.

turns.text: That sounds easy.

turns.text: Yes. Join our Telegram group, you'll get the first tasks and payment today itself.

turns.text: Great. For the premium tasks, you need to deposit five thousand. You'll get back eight thousand.

turns.text: Deposit?

turns.text: Yes, it's a prepaid task. Everyone in the group is earning. Please do it today, the slots are limited.

turns.text: I'm not sure.

turns.text: Guaranteed?

turns.text: Haan sir, har hafte bees percent return. Aapko bas hamare app pe invest karna hai.

turns.text: Kaun sa app?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Link bhejta hoon, wahan account banao aur pachaas hazaar se start karo.

turns.text: No thanks.

turns.text: Thank you ma'am, he's letting me in now. Two minutes.

turns.text: Okay, thanks.

turns.text: Hello sir, Amazon se delivery hai, main aapke building ke neeche hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, aa raha hoon.

turns.text: Thank you.

turns.text: Haan, saath do ek nau.

turns.text: Thik hai madam, cylinder rakh diya. Payment online ho chuka hai.

turns.text: Theek hai, dhanyavaad.
