turns.text: Haan ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke car loan ki EMI is mahine ki baaki hai, saat tareekh tak bhar dijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, bhar dunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Late hone pe late fee lag sakti hai. Aap branch mein ya app se bhar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, I'm calling from the credit card team. Your statement is generated and the minimum due is four thousand.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The due date is the twentieth. Paying only the minimum will attract interest, so we suggest paying the full amount if possible.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can pay via net banking or the app. We will never ask for your card details on call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi sir, this is a courtesy call from the bank about your personal loan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your last EMI bounced due to insufficient balance. There's a bounce charge of five hundred.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I forgot to transfer money.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please deposit the EMI amount in your account by Friday, it will be re-presented. You can visit the branch if you want to discuss.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I'll do it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, main gold loan department se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, boliye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke gold loan ka interest teen mahine se pending hai. Agle mahine tak nahi bhara toh auction notice aa sakta hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, main iss hafte branch aa jaungi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai madam, branch mein ya app pe hi payment kijiye. Hum phone pe payment nahi lete.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, I'm calling from the insurance company. Your policy premium is due next week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The premium is eighteen thousand six hundred. After the grace period, the policy may lapse.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll pay it this week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can pay on our website or app. Do you want me to send the payment link to your registered email?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please send it there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, this is from the bank. We're calling about your two wheeler loan which is closing next month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, nice.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: After the last EMI, you'll get a no objection certificate. You'll need it to remove the hypothecation from the RC.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How do I get it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It will be sent to your registered address, or you can collect it from the branch.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir namaste, aapke credit card ka bill due hai, aaj last date hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Arre haan, bhool gaya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi sir, aaj raat tak app se bhar dijiye, late fee nahi lagegi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai, abhi karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you sir. Aur haan, hum kabhi card details ya OTP phone pe nahi maangte.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, this is the school fee loan team. Your EMI date is changing from next month due to the system upgrade.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Changing to what?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: From the fifth to the tenth of every month. No action is needed from your side.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You'll get an SMS confirmation. If you have doubts, please call the number printed on your loan documents.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure, thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the fraud monitoring team from your bank. We noticed a transaction of thirty two thousand at an electronics store.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No! I didn't make that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for confirming. We have declined it and temporarily blocked the card for your safety.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What do I do now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A replacement card will be sent to your address. Please never share your OTP or PIN with anyone, the bank will never ask.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, aapke bank ki fraud prevention team se bol rahe hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke card se abhi ek international transaction try hua, kya aapne kiya?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nahi, maine nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, humne usko rok diya hai aur card block kar diya hai. Naya card aapke ghar aa jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aur sir, koi bhi aapse OTP ya PIN maange toh mat batana, bank kabhi nahi maangta.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ji, samajh gaya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi ma'am, I'm calling from your credit card company to confirm a purchase. Did you just buy a flight ticket for fifty one thousand?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, that was me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you ma'am, we've approved it. It was flagged only because it's higher than your usual spend.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No action is needed. Have a great trip.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, this is the bank's security team. Someone attempted to log into your net banking from a new device.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That wasn't me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have locked the net banking access for now. To unlock it, please visit the branch or reset it on the official app using your own registered number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't share any codes with callers, including us. We will not ask for them.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Got it, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening, I'm calling from your bank. We sent you an alert about a UPI collect request from an unknown account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I saw it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please decline it. Approving a collect request takes money out of your account; you never need to approve a request to receive money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I declined it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good. If you lost money, call the cybercrime helpline nineteen thirty immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, bank se bol rahi hoon. Aapke account mein do din se kuch unusual transactions dikh rahe hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kaun se?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Teen chhote transactions ek naye merchant ko. Kya aapne kiye?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, wo maine subscription liya tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai madam, confirm karne ke liye shukriya. Aage se koi problem ho toh card ke peeche wale number pe call kijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is your bank. Your debit card was used at an ATM in another city ten minutes ago. Was that you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, my card is with me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It may be a cloned card. We've blocked it right away. Please change your PIN on the app and visit the branch for a new card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will I get the money back?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We've raised a dispute. You'll get an SMS with the reference number. Please also file a complaint on the cybercrime portal.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I will.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi sir, I'm from the bank's customer care, you had called us about a failed transfer.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, the money got debited but didn't reach.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I checked, it's stuck at the beneficiary bank. It will reverse automatically within three working days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is there anything I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir. Please don't share any details if someone else calls you about this. We already have your complaint number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning ma'am, calling from the bank about the dispute you raised for the online purchase.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, any update?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The merchant has accepted the refund. You'll see the credit in your account within five days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Great.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help with today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir namaste, bank se bol raha hoon. Aapke account ka mobile number change karne ki request aayi hai, kya aapne di?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nahi, maine koi request nahi di.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai sir, humne request reject kar di hai. Aap branch aakar apna KYC update kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Koi khatra toh nahi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Abhi account safe hai sir. Bas kisi ko OTP ya password mat batana.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai, dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Constable Yadav from the local police station, for your passport verification.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I applied last month.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll come to your address tomorrow between ten and twelve. Please keep your Aadhaar and address proof ready.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure, I'll be home.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's no fee for verification. If anyone asks you for money, please inform the station.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste ji, thane se bol raha hoon. Aapke kiraayedaar ki police verification ke liye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan ji, form bhara tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kal shaam ko unhe ID proof leke thane bhej dijiye. Aapka signature bhi chahiye hoga.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, bhej dunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi fees nahi hai, bas documents le aana.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the traffic police control room. Your vehicle was involved in a minor accident report filed by another driver.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, someone scratched my car yesterday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The other party has filed a complaint. Please come to the traffic police station with your licence and RC to give a statement.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can I come on Saturday?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, Saturday is fine. Ask for the duty officer. There's no payment involved.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon sir, I'm calling from the court registry regarding your hearing date.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: For the property case?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir. The hearing has been moved to the twentieth. Your lawyer has been informed as well.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thanks for letting me know.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can check the status on the court website with your case number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the cyber crime police station. You had filed a complaint about an online fraud last week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I lost eighteen thousand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We've traced part of it and requested the bank to freeze the receiving account. We need you to come and sign a statement.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: When should I come?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Any weekday before five. Bring your bank statement. We will never ask you to pay anything to recover money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, main beat constable bol raha hoon. Aapke mohalle mein kal raat chori hui thi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, suna maine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hum sabke ghar pe CCTV footage check kar rahe hain. Aapke gate ka camera chalu hai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kal subah team aayegi footage dekhne. Aapko kuch dena nahi hai, bas camera ka access chahiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from the regional passport office. There's a discrepancy in your date of birth on the application.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, what's wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It doesn't match your school certificate. Please book an appointment online and bring the original documents.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't pay any agent. The appointment and correction are done only through the official portal.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening, this is the police station. We found a wallet with your driving licence in it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh wow, I lost it on Monday!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can collect it from the station tomorrow with another ID proof.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is there any charge?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No charge at all. Just ask for the duty officer at the front desk.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi papa, it's Ananya. How are you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hi beta, all good. How's college?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good papa. The semester fee notice came, it's sixty two thousand, due by the fifteenth.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, send me the fee portal details.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll send the link from the college website. No hurry, you can do it this week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure, I'll pay it on the weekend.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy, Rahul bol raha hoon. Ghar pe sab theek?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan beta, sab theek. Tu bata.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy is mahine hostel ka mess bill thoda zyada aaya hai, teen hazaar extra chahiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, kal bhej dungi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi jaldi nahi hai mummy, Sunday tak chalega. Papa ko bhi bata dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, bata dungi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey bhaiya, it's Sneha. Can I borrow five thousand till my salary on the first?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My laptop charger died and I need a new one for work. I'll return it on the first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No problem, I'll send it on your usual UPI.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks bhaiya! Tell bhabhi I said hi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan dada ji, main Vinay. Aapki dawai khatam ho gayi kya?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan beta, kal se nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main medical store pe hoon, chaar sau ki aa rahi hai. Main de deta hoon, aap baad mein de dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha beta, shukriya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi. Shaam ko ghar pe deke jaata hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi ma, it's me. The landlord said the rent goes up by two thousand from next month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay. Can you manage?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mostly, but can you add it to the monthly transfer? Only if it's okay.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I'll increase it from next month.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks ma. I'll call on Sunday as usual.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, take care.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mrs Gupta, it's Kavya, your neighbour. I paid the society maintenance for both of us since you were travelling.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, that's so kind of you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was two thousand four hundred for your flat. Send it whenever you're back, no rush.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll send it tonight on UPI.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, no problem. Hope the trip was good!

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: It was, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bhai, Ravi bol raha hoon. Goa trip ka booking ho gaya, tera share aath hazaar hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, kab tak dena hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Agle hafte tak de dena. Main sabko spreadsheet bhej raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, salary aate hi bhejta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan bhai, koi tension nahi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Done.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi beta, it's your mother. I need a small help, can you pay my electricity bill on your app? The website is not opening for me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure ma, how much is it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: One thousand eight hundred. The consumer number is on the bill, I'll send a photo on WhatsApp.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, send it, I'll pay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you beta. I'll give you the money when you come home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Don't worry about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey, it's Aditya. The cricket club annual fee is due, fifteen hundred each.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, who do I pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay the club treasurer directly, his UPI is on the group. Deadline is the end of the month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: See you at practice on Saturday.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: See you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Papa, Priya bol rahi hoon. Coaching ki fees ka message aaya, baarah hazaar.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha beta, last date kab hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pandrah tareekh. Main receipt WhatsApp kar dungi, aap online bhar dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, kar dunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you papa. Mummy ko bolna main raat ko call karungi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, bata dunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from a broadband company. We have a new fibre plan in your area at five ninety nine per month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I already have a connection.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem sir. This plan has double the speed and free installation if you switch this month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'm happy with my current plan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure sir, I'll note that. Thank you for your time.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, main ek real estate company se bol raha hoon. Hamare naye project mein two BHK flat available hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Mujhe abhi zaroorat nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam bas ek baar site visit kar lijiye, iss mahine booking pe discount hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nahi, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi madam, agar kabhi interest ho toh hamari website dekh lijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening ma'am, I'm calling from a health insurance company. Do you have a family floater policy?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, through my office.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Office policies sometimes have low cover, ma'am. We have a top up plan for just a few hundred a month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll think about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure ma'am, can I email you the brochure?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, send it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi sir, I'm calling from a credit card company. You're eligible for a new card with airport lounge access.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I already have two cards.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This one has no joining fee for the first year, sir. You can apply on our website if you're interested.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Not interested right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem sir, have a good day.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: You too.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir namaste, hum ek mutual fund company se hain. SIP ke baare mein jaankari dena chahte the.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Main pehle se SIP karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bahut accha sir. Hamari bhi kuch nayi schemes hain, aap chahein toh advisor se meeting set kar dete hain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Abhi nahi, shukriya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai sir, dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, I'm calling from a solar panel company. The government subsidy for rooftop solar is available this year.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, how much is the subsidy?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It depends on the capacity, ma'am. Our engineer can do a free site survey and explain.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Maybe next month.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure ma'am, I'll call next month. You can also check the official subsidy portal.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is from an online learning platform. You had downloaded our app. Are you interested in the data science course?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Maybe, what's the fee?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Forty five thousand, with EMI options. The batch starts next month, and early registration gets a discount.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll check the syllabus first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, I'll send it on email. No obligation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, car service center se bol rahe hain. Aapki gaadi ki service due hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, pata hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is hafte booking karenge toh free car wash milega. Kaun sa din theek rahega?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Shanivaar ko kar do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai sir, shanivaar das baje book kar diya. Payment service ke baad hogi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the clinic. Your appointment with Dr Rao is tomorrow at eleven.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I'll be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please come fifteen minutes early and bring your previous reports.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you need to reschedule, just call us back on this number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan madam, plumber Ramesh bol raha hoon. Main thoda late ho jaunga, traffic hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, kitna time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aadha ghanta. Tab tak main valve band kar dijiye taaki paani na bahe.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, kar diya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bas aa raha hoon. Payment kaam ke baad de dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from your son's school. This is his class teacher.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes ma'am, is everything okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's fine. We have a parent teacher meeting on Saturday at ten, I wanted to make sure you can come.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, we'll be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Also, the annual day fee of five hundred can be paid at the school office.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the landlord. The plumber will come on Wednesday to fix the leak in your bathroom.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Great, what time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Around four. Please be home or leave the key with the watchman.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll leave the key.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, thanks. Also the rent for next month is the same, no change.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, main society ka secretary bol raha hoon. Kal subah paani band rahega, tank ki safai hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, kitne baje tak?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Subah aath se dopahar do baje tak. Pehle se paani bhar ke rakh lijiye.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Theek hai, bataane ke liye shukriya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi sir.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ji.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the AC repair shop. The technician found that the compressor needs replacement.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh no, how much will it cost?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About nine thousand with the part. It's under warranty for six months after repair.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me think and call you back.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, take your time. We'll keep the unit here till you decide.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, it's the hospital lab. Your blood test reports are ready.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, can you send them?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: They're on the app and we've emailed them too. The doctor wants you to come for a follow up this week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is anything serious?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nothing urgent, just a routine review. You can book through the app.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello bhaiya, cab driver bol raha hoon. Main aapke building ke gate pe hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Do minute mein aata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai sir. Ride ka OTP bata dena jab aaoge.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, bata dunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main white car mein hoon, number plate pe last digits do ek do.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ok, aa raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the gym. Your membership expires next week.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can renew it at the front desk or on the app. There's a ten percent discount on annual plans this month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll renew at the desk.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great, see you there.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Bye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the vet clinic. Bruno's vaccination is due on Monday.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh right, thanks for reminding.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you bring him at five in the evening?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, five works.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great, see you on Monday. Please bring his vaccination card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey, did you hear about Meena aunty? Someone called her pretending to be from the bank and she shared her OTP.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh no! Did she lose money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Almost forty thousand. The caller said her account would be blocked if she didn't verify.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's terrible.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please tell your parents too, banks never ask for OTP on call. If anyone does, just hang up.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I'll tell them today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yaar, mere chacha ko kal ek call aaya tha, bol rahe the CBI se hain aur digital arrest kar diya hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kya? Phir?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Unhone bola kisi ko mat batao aur paise safe account mein daalo. Chacha bahut dar gaye the.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Paise diye kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi, meri behen ne dekh liya aur call kat diya. Police aise phone pe arrest nahi karti.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sahi kiya. Main bhi ghar pe bataunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi ma, I'm sending you a video about the new scam where they ask you to install AnyDesk for a refund.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, what happens?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Once you install it, they can see your screen and take money from your bank app.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Scary.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: So if anyone says install this app or share the screen, just cut the call and call me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, this is the bank's awareness team. We're informing customers about fake KYC calls.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fraudsters say your account will be frozen and ask for OTP or card details. The bank never does that.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Good to know.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you get such a call, report it at nineteen thirty or on the cybercrime portal. Thank you for your time.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bhai sun, office group pe ek message aaya hai, task wala scam chal raha hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kaun sa task?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: YouTube like karne ke paise dete hain, phir bolte hain premium task ke liye paise jama karo.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan maine bhi suna hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kabhi bhi pehle paise mat dena. Sab ko bata dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan bhai, zaroor.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey, my cousin got a call saying a parcel in his name had drugs and he must transfer money to clear his name.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That's the digital arrest scam!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly. They even made a video call with a fake police uniform.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Did he pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, he called the real police station and they told him it's fake. Real police never ask for money on video call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Glad he checked.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi dad, quick thing. If someone calls saying I'm in trouble and need money, call me first on my number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why, did something happen?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, it's a scam going around. They pretend to be your son from a new number and ask for urgent money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I'll always call you first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Also ask a question only I would know. Love you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Love you too.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aunty ji, main Pooja. Aapko koi bijli vibhag se call aaye ki aaj raat light kat jayegi toh mat ghabrana.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kyun beta?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wo fraud hai, link bhej ke paise le lete hain. Bill hamesha official app se hi bharna.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha, theek hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi bhi doubt ho toh mujhe call kar lena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan beta, shukriya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for calling customer care, this is Ravi. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: My UPI payment failed but money was debited.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Can you confirm your registered mobile number? I won't need your PIN or OTP.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Sure, it ends with four two one.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. The amount will be auto reversed within forty eight hours. Here's your complaint reference.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thanks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, telecom customer care mein aapka swagat hai. Main aapki kya madad kar sakti hoon?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Mera internet nahi chal raha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main check karti hoon. Aapke area mein maintenance chal raha hai, do ghante mein theek ho jayega.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi aur samasya ho toh app pe complaint daal sakte hain. Dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the electricity board helpline, returning your call about the high bill.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, it's double this month.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I checked your meter reading. There was an estimated reading last month, so this month includes the difference.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, that explains it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can pay it in two instalments through the official app if you want.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That helps, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, you've reached the airline's support desk. How can I help?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I need to cancel my flight next week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can help. For security, please confirm the booking reference and your name. We'll never ask for card details.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: It's on my email, let me read it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Got it. The cancellation refund will go back to the original payment method in seven days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, please cancel it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, aapne online store pe return ki complaint daali thi, main uske baare mein call kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Haan, jootey chhote the.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pickup kal ho jayega sir. Pickup ke time delivery boy aapse OTP maangega, wo de dena.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accha. Refund kab aayega?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pickup ke baad paanch din mein, original payment method mein. Aapko kuch install ya pay nahi karna hai.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thik hai, dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from the bank's call centre, regarding the cheque book request you placed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I asked for a new one.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It has been dispatched and should reach in five working days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Great.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with? Remember, the bank never asks for OTP or PIN.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is support from the food delivery app. You had complained about a missing item.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, the dessert was missing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sorry about that. We've refunded one hundred eighty rupees to your app wallet.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You don't need to share any details. The refund is already done.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Great.
